summary.name: Kitmul
summary.one_liner: Kitmul is a free website offering 538 calculators, converters, PDF, image, video, developer and text tools that run locally in the browser without file uploads.
use_cases: Merge, split or edit PDFs without uploading confidential documents
Compress or convert images directly in the browser
Convert units or run math and finance calculations quickly
Format, encode or debug JSON, CSV and other developer data
Generate secure passwords and random values
Embed a single tool on your own website
summary.what_it_does: Kitmul is a collection of 538 free tools grouped into 23 categories, including calculators, unit converters, PDF tools, image and video tools, developer utilities, data converters, CSS generators, text tools, music (BPM detection, stems) and security/cryptography tools. The page states that files and data are processed locally in the browser via JavaScript and are not sent to Kitmul's servers. Each tool can be shared by link or embedded on another site with a snippet. The FAQ says many utilities keep working offline once the page has loaded. The site uses Google Analytics for anonymous site metrics, according to the FAQ. The listing describes it as 100+ AI-powered tools, while the page itself frames its tools mainly as local, non-AI utilities.
notable: Client-side processing: files and calculations stay in the browser, with no uploads
538 tools across 23 categories, with no signup required
Many tools work offline after the page loads
Tools can be shared by link or embedded on other websites with a snippet
caveats: Page says it is free forever, but it also states Google Analytics is used for anonymous site metrics
Offline use applies to 'many' utilities, not necessarily all of them
The listing's 'AI-powered' label is not clearly backed by specifics on the page
